questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: Which of the following is a physical change?

distractor_reasoning.A: Rusting is a chemical change (forms iron oxide, new substance) -- commonly mistaken as physical.
distractor_reasoning.B: Burning is a chemical change (combustion produces new substances).
distractor_reasoning.D: Digestion involves chemical breakdown of food into new substances.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: The functional unit of the kidney is called the:

distractor_reasoning.A: Confuses the kidney's functional unit with the nervous system's functional unit.
distractor_reasoning.C: Confuses with the functional unit of the lungs.
distractor_reasoning.D: Confuses with the structure in the small intestine responsible for absorption.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the:

distractor_reasoning.A: This is the unit of current, not resistance.
distractor_reasoning.B: This is the unit of potential difference, not resistance.
distractor_reasoning.D: This is the unit of power, not resistance.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: A concave mirror always forms a virtual image when the object is placed:

options.C: Between the pole and the focus

distractor_reasoning.A: Object beyond C gives a real, diminished image, not virtual.
distractor_reasoning.B: At focus, the image forms at infinity (real, highly enlarged), not virtual.
distractor_reasoning.D: At C, the image forms at C itself, real and same size, not virtual.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: The ozone layer protects the Earth from which type of radiation?

distractor_reasoning.A: Confuses UV with infrared, both often grouped loosely as 'invisible radiation' by students.
distractor_reasoning.C: Not typically associated with atmospheric filtering at this level.
distractor_reasoning.D: Not typically associated with atmospheric filtering at this level.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: The pH of a neutral solution at room temperature is:

distractor_reasoning.A: Confuses neutral pH with the most acidic end of the scale.
distractor_reasoning.C: Confuses neutral pH with the most basic end of the scale.
distractor_reasoning.D: Assumes a strongly acidic value is 'neutral', a common early misconception.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: True or False: A balanced chemical equation must have an equal number of atoms of each element on both sides.

answer_key.explanation: True -- this reflects the law of conservation of mass.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: True or False: Respiration in plants occurs only during the day.

answer_key.explanation: False -- respiration occurs continuously (day and night); only photosynthesis is light-dependent.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: True or False: Connecting resistors in parallel always increases the total resistance of the circuit.

answer_key.explanation: False -- parallel combination always decreases the total (equivalent) resistance.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: True or False: Traits acquired by an organism during its lifetime can be passed on to its offspring.

answer_key.explanation: False -- acquired characteristics are not heritable; only genetic (germline) changes are passed on.

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: Explain why the small intestine in humans is long and has a highly folded inner surface.

rubric_points: States the small intestine is the main site of digestion and absorption of nutrients
Explains the folded surface (villi/microvilli) increases surface area
Connects greater surface area to more efficient absorption of digested food into the blood

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: Explain why displacement reactions occur between metals, using the example of iron reacting with copper sulphate solution.

rubric_points: States a more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its salt solution
Identifies iron is more reactive than copper (based on reactivity series)
Describes iron displacing copper: Fe + CuSO4 -> FeSO4 + Cu, with the blue solution fading and a reddish-brown deposit forming

questions.subject: CBSE Class 10 Science
questions.question_text: Explain how deforestation contributes to soil erosion.

rubric_points: States tree roots bind soil particles together, holding topsoil in place
Explains that without tree cover, rain/wind directly hits and washes away exposed topsoil
Notes the loss of topsoil reduces fertility and can lead to desertification over time
